name: send_plan_shared
description: A pupil's SEN support plan or pupil passport, shared with contacts with parental responsibility.
subject: {plan_kind} - {pupil_name}
body: Here is {pupil_name}'s {plan_kind}, setting out what we know, the outcomes we are working towards and the support in place.
If you have any questions or would like to add anything, please contact the school's SENCO.

placeholders.pupil_name: The pupil's preferred first name and surname
placeholders.sender_name: The member of staff sending it
